name: paneline

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:store

description: Claude Code mod (plugin) that adds a side pane with Activity, Files, Agents, Plan, Context, MCP, Skills, Spend, Setup, Shells, History, Review and Sessions tabs, a status line above the prompt, a restyled chat, Mermaid diagrams in the terminal, tables, and code and diff panels. Colours follow both /color and the /theme (dark, light and others).
author: Mark Neonin
